notes.title: Release 2.0 ! Bug Fixed
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:
- Fixed the file number verification in the last stage of the game.

notes.title: Patch - Train level
notes.notes:
Bug Fixed


 Fixed the issue of the lady in the train level running too fast.


Improvements


 Added a sprint option in the train level; you can use sprint to escape from the lady in the train level.
 Increase the area of light in the dark room in the train level.

notes.title: Patch Small
notes.notes:
Bug Fixed


 Issue of wrong file number (dummy 1.txt shown as dummy 0.txt) fixed.

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes: When you finish the game the first time and choose to go for the second ending, a new button in the main menu will be created, which will help you to understand how the game world works.

notes.title: Patch 4.1
notes.notes: Fixed issue of inventory not opening at starting game.

notes.title: Patch 4
notes.notes:
Fixed the issue of Polish localization.
 Added random ambient sound.

notes.title: Patch 3
notes.notes:
Fixed issue where player couldn’t sprint in the train level
 Reworked Blue Door locking mechanic
 Increased player stamina level
 Added in-game instructions for unlocking other endings

notes.title: Patch 2
notes.notes:
Shotgun power increased
 Boss health reduced
 Minor gameplay-related additions
 World data file improved for better understanding
 Train level room numbers updated
 Fixed falling issue in kitchen
 Fixed falling issue in morgue
 Fixed issue where pause and inventory were accessible after closing the locker
 Fixed item spawn positions that were out of player's reach
 Increased player speed in the prologue
 Fixed Blue Door not opening after saving
 Fixed tablet assignment issue on basement door
 Fixed boss spawning in the wrong area after saving
 Fixed typewriter issue in the second part of the game
 Fixed "File" button not working in pause menu
 Fixed password file verification
 Fixed UI in dark level
 Fixed room lighting in two levels
 Fixed locker password issues for Lockers F and G
 Fixed camera not moving in Level 5
 Fixed puzzle button UI text
 Updated content in the red file
 Fixed issue with the decryption key not working
